title: NanoCharge Navigator — per-message footprint lens and export flows
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Design and prototype a compact, role-aware per-message cost lens (NanoCharge Navigator) for the Redwood Console. Goals: 1) show per-invocation token footprint and SKU mapping with toggles for batching/quantization sensitivity; 2) enable attribution from prompt fragments -> model tokens -> cost line items; 3) provide export bundles (CSV/NDJSON) that preserve lineage for downstream chargeback and billing systems. Deliverables: Figma prototype, annotated acceptance criteria, export format spec, lightweight demo in Playbook. This ticket focuses on UX patterns for compact views (sparklines + micro-histograms), interaction states for rollups, and CSV/NDJSON export shape that preserves prompt offsets and role metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype includes a compact header card showing total microcost, 7-day delta, and dominant SKU
Detail-expanded row shows token-by-token attribution for a sampled invocation with hover-to-highlight prompt span
Export button provides 2 formats: summarized CSV (route, date, tokens, cost) and lineage NDJSON (invocation id, prompt spans, token ranges, cost entries)
Role-aware filtering (system/user/assistant) toggles must persist across pagination and exports
Design signoff from PM and Eng with implementation notes for quantization/batching toggles
comments: 2026-02-25 Aisha Khan: Kickoff — initial problem statement and scope. Emphasis on compactness for busy PMs and engineering leads. Requesting design constraints for export schema from Eng.
2026-02-27 Marin Blake: Early wireframes uploaded to Figma. Two layout options: 'line-item stack' vs 'condensed matrix'. Leaning to condensed matrix for better scanability on dashboards.

2026-02-28 Chris Nguyen (Eng): Provided backend constraints — payloads should avoid per-token arrays larger than 2k elements in listing endpoints. Suggested sampled-token views and on-demand expansion.

2026-03-01 PM review (Leah Ortiz): Ask to surface SLA-impacting invocations (high-latency & high-cost) with a single click to open the trace panel. Also: include a quick compare toggle to show pre/post quantization estimates.
2026-03-03 Design critique: Jakob (Design Lead) recommended adding a colorblind-safe palette, microcopy for 'estimated vs billed' costs, and an affordance for role-based masking (PII concerns).
2026-03-04 Engineering feedback: Miguel Ortega notes that lineage NDJSON should include invocation.version and runtime.variant keys so downstream billing can tie to model rollouts.

2026-03-05 Marin Blake: Prototype updated to v2 with hover-to-highlight prompt span, sampled-token expansion, and CSV export preview. Ready for PM/Eng signoff; filed a follow-up ENG task for backend sampling endpoints (ENG-31021).
2026-03-05 Leah Ortiz (PM): Approving prototype pending two small changes — add 'export size estimate' modal and include per-export retention label.
decisions: Use two-tier exports: lightweight CSV for analytics teams and lineage NDJSON for chargeback/forensics
Default UI shows sampled token attribution; full token streaming available via on-demand expansion to respect API payload limits
Quantization and batching toggles will be client-side estimators tied to model-variant metadata provided in header payloads
next_steps: ENG: Implement sampling endpoint and NDJSON schema (ENG-31021)
DES: Finalize microcopy and accessibility pass (contrast, colorblind-safe palette)
PM: Add export retention option to pricing policy docs and coordinate with legal on lineage retention limits
